title: Time limit for filing Returns under Regulation 21 of IRDAI (Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors) Regulations, 2015
full_text:
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA ## # **Re: Time limit for filing Returns under Regulation 21 of IRDAI (Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors) Regulations, 2015** are required to submit the Annual policy and Quarterly/Halfyearly returns. **Name of the Report Time Limit** Within 90 days of from the - FY - quarter - Half Yearly report on claims Within 45 days From the end of half year - clarified that even if there is no change in the policy, the Authority should be ~mlJL--
- : Bhavan, 3rd Floor, Basheer Bagh, Hyderabad - 500 004. India. > 1100/300, Fax: +91-40-6682 3334
